request.text: A single delightful collectible pickup for a warm childhood adventure game in an Iranian garden: two bright delicate hammered santur notes rising, a tiny soft metallic key jingle underneath, intimate and magical, dry close recording, immediate attack, short clean decay. No voice, no background ambience, no ongoing music.
One small old brass lock clicking open, quick tactile metallic clack, warm dry close foley for a gentle adventure game. Immediate single click and brief decay, no echo, no voices, no music.

A small old iron garden cage gate opens: brief latch release followed by a soft hinge creak and light metal settling. Warm intimate game foley, not ominous, immediate start, no voices or music or background.

One child-sized body splashes into a shallow garden pond, rounded cheerful water plop followed by small sparkling droplets settling. Close natural game foley, immediate splash, no voices, no music or ambient background.
A single continuous four-second spray-paint can hiss, soft airy aerosol texture, even pressure, quick start and clean stop. Dry close foley, no shaking can, no voices, no music or background.
